description: Write runner init file from plain String parameters.

TailnetWaitSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for the user-data tailnet join before registering; 0 skips the wait

runCommand: if [ "$W" -gt 0 ]; then while [ "$i" -lt "$W" ] && [ ! -s "$T" ]; do sleep 2; i=$((i+2)); done; if grep -qx up "$T" 2>/dev/null; then echo "tailnet: up"; else echo "tailnet: unavailable"; fi; fi
M=65536; C=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/threads-max); if [ "$C" -lt "$M" ]; then sysctl -w kernel.threads-max=$M; fi
